name: pantry_02_normalize_text
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION atlas_core.pantry_02_normalize_text(value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select nullif(
    pg_catalog.normalize(pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(value, '')), 'NFC'),
    ''
  );
$function$

name: pantry_02_sha256
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION atlas_core.pantry_02_sha256(value jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select pg_catalog.encode(
    extensions.digest(
      pg_catalog.convert_to(coalesce(value, 'null'::jsonb)::text, 'UTF8'),
      'sha256'
    ),
    'hex'
  );
$function$
